title: Modern
summary: Fast editorial opener style: a near-black charcoal canvas around full-bleed vertical pictures, colour only from the footage. The frame splits into 2-3 staggered vertical strips, a 2x2 mosaic, a slot that widens or a centred card that punches up to full frame on the beat. One huge white word in heavy geometric capitals (Montserrat 800) builds and drops out letter by letter in a scattered order, each letter passing through a translucent ghost. Small widely tracked Inter Tight labels, Space Mono frame numbers. Hard cuts, expo-out arrivals, a 0.2 s beat grid. Original work in the genre.
